description: Maps Universal Dependencies v2 part-of-speech tags onto ud_v1, the tagset Brain.ML.POSTagger uses. UD v2 split v1's CONJ into CCONJ (coordinating: and, or) and SCONJ (subordinating: if, because); every other tag is the same in both. A v2 tag with no entry here fails the import rather than being coerced.
